narr: The base of an upper trough nosed into north Alabama and provided lift along a diffuse surface boundary. Thunderstorms with heavy rainfall developed along and south of the Interstate 20 corridor during the afternoon hours. A few of the storms produced rainfall totals of 1 to 3 inches in a short period of time.
ev: Significant flooding in the city of Alabaster. Water over bridges and several roads impassable including Highway 119, Highway 31, 1st Street West, and Highway 11.
lsr: SIGNIFICANT FLOODING IN SEVERAL SPOTS AROUND ALABASTER. WATER WAS OVER BRIDGES AND ROADWAYS WERE IMPASSABLE.
